package observer_test

import (
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/platform/baselineobservation"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/root"
	"github.com/portpowered/infinite-you/pkg/services/edges"
	"testing"
)

// Q0 only constructs the inert public process. Lifecycle checkpoints belong to
// the next story; this probe does not certify admitted runtime provenance.
func TestInProcessObserverQ0(t *testing.T) {
	if testing.Short() {
		t.Skip("explicit owner diagnostics only")
	}
	baselineobservation.Close()
	t.Cleanup(baselineobservation.Close)
	process, err := root.BuildProcess(t.Context(), edges.Edges{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := process.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	snapshots, err := baselineobservation.Capture()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	found := map[string]bool{}
	for _, snapshot := range snapshots {
		found[snapshot.Kind] = true
		t.Logf("Q0 actual constructor callback: %#v", snapshot)
	}
	if !found["instance_host"] || !found["models_leases"] {
		t.Fatalf("incomplete constructor inventory: %v", found)
	}
}
